plain.li: Ah. There it is.
Close the door. Close it.
Give it a minute. Then you won't want to leave.
I can feel my toes again. All ten.
[snow] Snow on my boots, and in here it's summer.
[evening] Best part of the day, this.
[old] My knees thank you. My back thanks you.
[lowtech] Another ladle on the stones, if you can reach.
[child] It's so hot! Can I stay?

warm.li: Shift up, there's room for one more.
Everyone should come in here at least once a day.

cheerful.li: I'm going to sit here until I melt!
Who's going to roll in the snow after? Not me. Maybe me.

gloomy.li: Warm for an hour. Better than nothing.
The cold's waiting outside the door. Let it wait.

cold.li: Twenty minutes. Then back to work.

plain.li: {PAWN_nameDef} and {OTHER_nameDef} sat in the heat of the sauna and talked about nothing much until they were both red as beets.
{PAWN_nameDef} poured water on the heat and {OTHER_nameDef} complained, then asked for more.
In the sauna, {OTHER_nameDef} told {PAWN_nameDef} something {OTHER_pronoun} hadn't told anyone. The steam made it easier.
{PAWN_nameDef} and {OTHER_nameDef} sat shoulder to shoulder in the sauna, too warm to argue about anything.
[snow] {PAWN_nameDef} dared {OTHER_nameDef} to run out into the snow from the sauna. They both did, and both ran straight back in.
{PAWN_nameDef} and {OTHER_nameDef} compared aches in the sauna and agreed that {OTHER_nameDef}'s back was the worse of the two.
{OTHER_nameDef} fell asleep sitting up in the sauna, and {PAWN_nameDef} let {OTHER_objective} be until the heat woke {OTHER_objective}.

warm.li: {PAWN_nameDef} and {OTHER_nameDef} warmed up together in the sauna, and came out friends of a slightly better sort.

blunt.li: {PAWN_nameDef} told {OTHER_nameDef} to stop talking and sweat. {OTHER_nameDef} did, mostly.

cheerful.li: {PAWN_nameDef} sang in the sauna until {OTHER_nameDef} joined in, badly.

gloomy.li: {PAWN_nameDef} and {OTHER_nameDef} sat in the sauna and agreed the winter was too long. It helped, a bit.

plain.li: Two seeds to a hole. Two.
Straight rows, now. The neighbours are watching.
Mind where you're stepping, that row's done.
Who's got the seed basket?
Smell that soil. That's spring.
[rain] Perfect weather for it, whatever your boots say.
[lowtech] A handful for the birds, so they leave the rest.
[child] I'm planting a whole row by myself!

warm.li: Look how much we've done already. Good work, everyone.
Take a breather. The ground isn't going anywhere.

cheerful.li: I'll race you to the end of the row!
This is the best day of the year and nobody can tell me otherwise.

gloomy.li: All this, and one bad frost could take it.

cold.li: An even spacing gives a better yield. Keep it even.

plain.li: May it come up thick and green.
Rain enough, sun enough, and no more frost.
That's the year started, then.
Whatever comes up, we put it there together.
[lowtech] To the ground, and back to us in the autumn.
[rain] Listen to that. The fields are drinking.
Remember this evening when we're bringing it in.
Every row of it ours. Every one.

warm.li: Thank you, all of you. It's a good day's work.
Look at it. We did that, together.

cheerful.li: See you in the autumn, little ones!

gloomy.li: We've done our part. The rest is up to the weather.

cold.li: Sown on time. The harvest should follow.

plain.li: Come on, you. Home.
Easy, easy. This way.
Mind the gate. One at a time.
That's it. Nearly there.
Who's got the last one?
[snow] Keep moving, all of you. It's warmer inside.
[afterraid] Found another one. It's all right. They've gone.
[evening] In before dark. That's the rule.
[child] It's following me! It likes me!

warm.li: There you go. Warm straw tonight.

cheerful.li: Last one in gets the worst stall!

gloomy.li: It never wants to come in until it's too cold to stay out.

cold.li: Count them again at the door.

plain.li: [herd] Ropes, everyone. We're bringing the herd home.
[herd] Out to the grazing and back with every head of them. Come on.
[herd,snow] Before the snow gets deeper. Ropes, and quick.

warm.li: [herd] Let's get them in somewhere warm. They've earned it.

plain.li: [herd] We walked the herd in on ropes today, one by one. They're under a roof tonight.
[herd] Brought the animals home before the weather turned. My hands smell of rope and fleece.

warm.li: [herd] Brought the herd home with the others. Counting them in at the door is the best part.

plain.li: {NAME}, and {A_nameDef} has the seed sorted and the baskets by the door: everyone out to the fields together.
[first] {NAME} comes round for the first time. {A_nameDef} wants it kept with the sowing, everyone together, and a word at the end.
[years] {NAME} again, {YEARS} years on. The fields are waiting, and so is {A_nameDef}.
[tradition] {NAME}: everyone in the fields from the morning, a word at the edge in the evening. The colony knows how it goes.
[winter] {NAME}, though the ground's still hard. {A_nameDef} says they'll walk the fields together all the same, and plan the rows.
[lowtech] {NAME}. {A_nameDef} has a handful of grain set aside for the birds, as always.

cheerful.li: {NAME}! {A_nameDef} has been up since before dawn and is already muddy to the knees.

gloomy.li: {NAME}. {A_nameDef} says a year that starts well has a better chance, and they all need the chance.

plain.li: We kept {NAME} in the fields, all of us. My back aches and the rows are straight.
[first] The first time we kept {NAME}: seed in the ground and a word at the edge after. I think it'll stick.
[years] {NAME} again. Same fields, same seed baskets, a year older.
[tradition] {NAME}: the sowing together, as always. Some things are worth doing every year.

warm.li: {NAME}. Everyone in the fields, kneeling in the dirt side by side. I was glad of every one of them.

cheerful.li: {NAME}! I planted more than anyone. Nobody else was counting, but I was.

gloomy.li: {NAME}. We put it all in the ground and now it's up to the weather.

cold.li: {NAME}. A day of everyone's work at the right moment is worth a week of it later.

plain.li: {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} argued about the best spacing for the rows on {NAME}.
{A_nameDef} showed {B_nameDef} how {A_pronoun} was taught to sow, on {NAME}.
{A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef} what {A_pronoun} hopes will come up this year, on {NAME}.
[way:planting] {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} sorted seed together for tomorrow's planting day.
